patterns.name: direct_google_api
patterns.fix: Do not call Google directly; use /gmail (skills/gmail), which owns the REST API and OAuth.

patterns.name: oauth_in_code
patterns.fix: /gmail owns OAuth profiles and token storage. Never script a grant here.

patterns.name: hardcoded_credential
patterns.fix: No Gmail credential belongs in code.

patterns.name: send_attempt
patterns.fix: Sending goes through /gmail plan outbound + human approval code. Never send from this skill.

patterns.name: filter_mutation
patterns.fix: /gmail deliberately exposes no filter/forwarding mutation. Do not add one.

patterns.name: unredacted_body_store
patterns.fix: Mail bodies must not reach memory; extract relationship metadata only.

patterns.name: mcp_gmail_connector
patterns.fix: The MCP connector was the old transport. /gmail is API-first and is now the documented layer.
